authority_boundary_note: Browser-managed saved copies remain subordinate to the live current official page and the named official help lane the office actually stands behind.
browser_saved_copy_surface_label: Example browser-managed saved-copy posture for official voter-information routes
degraded_copy_recovery_note: If a saved copy loses scripts, assets, or interactive behavior, the route preserves a visible recovery path back to the current official page/help lane rather than pretending completeness.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official voter-information pages so browser-managed Reading List items, offline saved-page files, or archived page copies remain subordinate to the current live official page and named help lane rather than quietly becoming shadow portable editions.
high_risk_topic_routing_note: When saved-copy ambiguity affects deadline, location, eligibility, ID, cure, or rights-sensitive questions, the route moves the voter back to the current official help lane instead of pretending the saved copy settled the matter.
in_page_freshness_note: Time-sensitive routes keep freshness, election/date scope, and recheck-the-live-route cues inside the page content so later reopened copies remain visibly bounded.
portable_edition_boundary_note: User-created browser captures are not silently treated as the office's reviewed portable publication objects.
privacy_minimization_note: The service preserves route IDs, reviewed saved-copy context labels, policy notes, and timestamps rather than individualized reading-list contents, local file paths, or uploaded page archives.
